faqs.question: What is the starting price for the Jaisalmer Desert Adventure package?
faqs.answer: Starting at ₹21,300 per person on twin-sharing (Deluxe tier, land only — all-inclusive of GST). Standard tier from ₹16,400; Premium tier from ₹34,200. Full package with flights from ₹33,300.

faqs.question: When is the best time to book this trip?
faqs.answer: Recommended window: Oct–Mar. Book 30-60 days ahead for best hotel and flight rates; peak-season trips (festivals, New Year) often fill up earlier. Outside the recommended window the trip still operates but weather and inclusions can vary.

faqs.question: Are flights included?
faqs.answer: Land tiers are land-only (no flights). Full Package tier includes return economy flights from your selected Indian metro. Live fares are locked the day you confirm.

faqs.question: What documents do I need?
faqs.answer: Valid government photo ID for hotel check-in and any flights. For restricted-zone destinations (Ladakh, Sikkim, Arunachal, Nagaland), we handle the Inner Line Permit — share scanned IDs 7-10 days before travel.

faqs.question: Can I customise the itinerary?
faqs.answer: Yes — every element is customisable. Common changes: hotel category up/down, adding/removing cities, extending by 1-2 days, switching group to private. WhatsApp us your changes; revised quote in 24 hours.

faqs.question: What's the cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Cancel 30+ days out: 60% refund. Cancel 15-30 days out: 25% refund. Cancel within 15 days or no-show: no refund. Air tickets, visa fees and third-party non-refundables are 100% non-refundable from issuance. Refunds processed in 15-30 working days.

faqs.question: How do I pay?
faqs.answer: 25% on booking, 50% at 30 days before travel, 25% at 15 days before. UPI, NEFT and bank transfer have no extra charge. Cards have 2.5% gateway. International cards (Visa/MasterCard) accepted with applicable forex markup.

faqs.question: Is this trip suitable for solo / family / large group?
faqs.answer: Yes to all. Solo: single-occupancy supplement applies (~35% above twin-share). Family: child rates apply (free under 5, 50% age 5-11, full above 12). Group of 6+: ask for group rates — usually 10-15% better than published price.

faqs.question: What if something goes wrong during the trip?
faqs.answer: Your trip captain is on WhatsApp 24×7 with authority to fix problems — reroute transfers, change hotels on overbooking, coordinate doctor visits, manage flight delays.

faqs.question: Why book with TripFolks vs Wanderon, MMT or other operators?
faqs.answer: TripFolks works directly with TBO, MMT Partner and Riya as a B2B travel operator — real net rates, transparent margins, no aggregator markup. Every hotel is pre-inspected by our team, and the trip captain is a real human on WhatsApp 24×7.
